image_description: An interior view of a rustic sawmill or lumber processing facility. A man in a red plaid shirt and apron is operating a large bandsaw, guiding a long, rough-hewn wooden plank through the blade. The setting features exposed wooden beams, vertical log supports, and stacks of processed lumber in the foreground. Heavy industrial machinery with green painted metal components is visible in the background.
